authority.approval: user, 2026-09-25: run the controlled three-seed target-2 reward experiment if its registration and control checks pass; no pause between passing checks and training

question: Does btt_reward_v3_t2 (a one-time, time-sensitive credit of up to +2.0 for native target 2) make fresh v1 policies break the moving target 2 more often at 3,072,000 transitions than the historical btt_reward_v2 control, without losing static targets, and is the gain early enough to matter for a first clear (L, R)?

arms.T: m7l_t2_s{0,1,2}: fresh models, btt_reward_v3_t2, otherwise the Phase K v1 profile of the seed
arms.C: historical runs/m7g_k/m7g_s{0,1,2}_v1 (btt_reward_v2), reused only while the control check passes

only_experimental_change: the reward contract (btt_reward_v3_t2 instead of btt_reward_v2) and the native diagnostic flag it derives (SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG=1, read-only, gameplay-neutral)
sequencing: strictly sequential, one run at a time, in the order T0, T1, T2; the launch gate before each

reward.credit: 2.0 * (3600 - n) / 3600 once, on the step that first shows native target ID 2 broken

launch_gate.boundaries: inclusive; a missing reading fails; commit and physical evaluated separately
launch_gate.when: before every training launch (control check R1 and campaign runs)
launch_gate.readings: a failed reading is re-measured after 60 s, at most 5 readings; the run launches only on a passing reading; otherwise the campaign stops

in_run_memory_policy.physical: recorded and reported, never a stop trigger

registered_settings.monitor: m7d Monitor: hard alerts stop the run (an episode row that violates its btt_reward_v3_t2 closed form, more than 10 game processes or listeners in two samples, a changed user config, low disk)
stop_conditions: the in-run memory policy (a resource stop)
a process leak (leak_free false or a leftover BattleShip process)
registered_settings.after_a_stop: the campaign stops and reports; the stopped run directory is moved to _partial by the guard and preserved (never deleted, never resumed); nothing is relaunched in this milestone
registered_settings.evaluation: post hoc, frozen statistics, tick-0 starts only (Phase K protocol), btt_eval_metrics_v1 with SSB64_RL_TARGET_DIAG=1, clear verification of every native clear, census; then exact spatial replays (SSB64_RL_SPATIAL=1, read-only) of every final stochastic episode of both arms (approach zone, secondary)
registered_settings.training_inputs: tick-0 episodes of the run itself only; never the crossing fixtures, the TAS, feasibility traces, capture recordings, other runs or hand-written routes
registered_settings.never: native RNG state is never inspected, logged, validated, controlled, compared or hashed

R1.what: curriculum-off btt_reward_v2 runs of 102,400 transitions (rl/configs/m7h/gate/m7h_r1_s{s}.toml = the Phase K v1 profile, bounded) on the frozen code
R1.must_equal: the pinned policy / statistics digests (Phase K = M7e ckpt_000102400) and every episode row up to 102,400 (rank, worker episode, end, steps, targets, native action digest), 30 / 27 / 29 rows
R1.implementation: rl/m7h_run.py cmd_r1 into the campaign's _control tree, plus an M7l comparison against the Phase K checkpoint and rows

R2.what: re-evaluation of the three historical final checkpoints (100 deterministic + 100 stochastic each, 600 episodes) on the frozen code
R2.must_equal: native action digest, targets, end reason and btt_eval_metrics_v1 of every registered Phase K evaluation episode

R3.what: the M7l decision inputs recomputed from the R2 records and from the historical records
R3.must_equal: each other and the rule's known_control_values

historical_control.verification: python rl/m7l_campaign.py control-check (bound to the code fingerprint and executable)

evaluation_protocol.route_rows: every evaluation row equals its btt_reward_v3_t2 closed form (reward_v3 record) and its moving-target tick equals btt_eval_metrics_v1's
evaluation_protocol.spatial_replays: every final stochastic episode of both arms (600), exact, rl/m7k_target2.replay_one; descriptive
